description: JStock is open showing the default 'My Watchlist' containing 5 US tech stocks (AAPL, MSFT, GOOGL, AMZN, NVDA). Your task is to rename this watchlist to 'Tech Giants'. To do this, locate the watchlist tab labeled 'My Watchlist' (usually at the top of the Stock Watchlist view), right-click on the tab to access the context menu, select 'Rename', enter the new name 'Tech Giants' (with the space, capitalization matters), and press Enter to confirm. Verify that the tab now reads 'Tech Giants'.
